name: Fuels & Petroleum Chemistry
summary: Composition, refining and properties of fossil, bio- and synthetic fuels, including aviation and rocket kerosene.

topics.name: Formation and composition of petroleum, natural gas and coal
Crude-oil refining: distillation, cracking, reforming, alkylation and hydrotreating
Fuel properties: heating value, octane and cetane numbers, volatility and flash point
Gasoline, diesel and jet fuels (Jet A, JP-8, RP-1)
Biofuels: ethanol, biodiesel, renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel
Synthetic fuels: Fischer-Tropsch, methanol and e-fuels
Hydrogen, ammonia and methane as fuels
